finalText:
This is a small Node HTTP API, five files, no dependencies beyond the built-in `http` and `crypto` modules.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Client -->|Bearer token| server[server.js]
  server -->|checks token| auth[auth.js]
  server --> routes[routes.js]
  routes -->|reads| cache[cache.js] --> store[store.js]
  routes -->|writes| store
```

Each file has one job:

- `server.js` opens the HTTP port and checks the token on every request before anything else runs.
- `auth.js` makes and checks those tokens — a user ID plus a signed hash, using a secret from the environment.
- `routes.js` is a small lookup table matching method and path to a handler.
- `cache.js` is a 256-item memory cache that sits in front of reads only, so repeat lookups skip the store.
- `store.js` holds the actual data in memory, and quietly drops any record 15 minutes after it was last written.

Nothing here is a real database — it's all in memory, and it resets on restart. There's no `package.json` and no tests in the repo yet.
